payload.title: Anth.us: decide the legacy full build and the MDX normaliser
payload.description: build_via_papyrus.py main(), stage(), write_generated, relocate_pages, copy_static_root, write_custom_rules, anthus_content.discover and the Gatsby-era MDX path (anthus_mdx.py 1224 lines, mdx_codemod.py 914 lines) only serve the CMS staging preview (infra/site.json cms.stagingPreview.buildCommand) and local builds from the content submodule. The CMS app's staging branch (d7s858igkyct5) has never run a job. If Ryan agrees the preview is not wanted (or is replaced by a projection with drafts), delete them, bin/dev-server.py, bin/deploy-amplify.sh, bin/apply_custom_rules.py, customHttp.yml and cms.stagingPreview. Check first: projection of the 130 current items without normalize_body differs only by trailing whitespace (measured 2026-10-21); the {{pictogram}} token feature would go with it.
